highest_reported.source: Benguria and Loss (2004), unit-circle construction; see also Suragan arXiv:2609.10775v1
highest_reported.reproduction_status: The circle has curvature 1, and the periodic operator has spectrum 1+k^2 for k in the integers. Exact value 1 is independently recomputed. The Ovals conjecture that this is the global minimum remains open.

known_public_lower_bound.source: Suragan, An Improved Bound for the Ovals Problem, arXiv:2609.10775v1, 2026-09-09
known_public_lower_bound.reproduction_status: Reported theoretical lower bound; not independently reconstructed by this task.

parameters.curve_class: smooth strictly convex simple closed plane curves
parameters.objective: minimize joint Rayleigh quotient over curve and nonzero periodic trial function

T096-C01.optimality_status: Open: the 2026 source gives a lower bound below 1 and states that the sharp lower bound remains open.

details.objective_interval_meaning: Certified interval for this trial Rayleigh quotient only; the reported objective is its conservative upper endpoint, not a two-sided interval for the first eigenvalue.
details.curve_closure: mean rho is one and first harmonics vanish exactly

independent_quantity.method: Exact circle Parseval sum of Fourier energy weights n^2+1; no reciprocal series or angular sampling.
